Gallery — weather × time of day × lap position

TLX/three renderer, SwiftShader, 1024×576 capture, shown downscaled. Orbit camera (az 40°, el 24°, 70 m) at six lap fractions for each weather/time-of-day cell; plus eye and trackside (day dry). Committed as 900 px JPEG (q80, to keep the circuit folder ~3.7 MB; the task asked for .png names) under artifacts/shots/tracks/istanbul/, named istanbul-nn-view-fXX-tod-weather.jpg (the GALLERY.md canonical order: tod then weather).

day · dry

Day dry baseline.

day · wet

Wet: tarmac darkens and gains sheen; sky stays blue and unshadowed — reads as damp rather than wet. Day lighting is correct (not night).

day · rain

Rain: streaks visible, overcast tint; still daylight (PR #1979 fix visible).

day · overcast

Overcast grey sky, flatter light; kerbs and props keep colour.

day · fog

Fog: patchy ground haze; the sky stays saturated blue above the haze (fog does not tint the sky) and distant ridges stay crisp-blue-grey.

day · storm

Storm at day: dark grey, rain streaks, lights NOT night-black — daytime storm no longer looks like night (merge applied). Planar-reflection ghosting under pines.

dusk · dry

Dusk dry: warm low sun, lamp pools already firing on the lane; sky purple.

dusk · rain

Dusk rain: lamp pools and wet specular on the road.

night · dry

Night dry: lamp pools fire along the whole lap; grandstand and apartment slab stay bright (not lit by anything).

night · rain

Night rain: strong lamp reflections on the wet road; the apartment slab and the stand stay bright white — the props are not darkened.

Code & scenery deep-dive

Frame and anchors

  • measured def._sceneryShift is undefined and startFrac is 0; the def sets no sceneryStartFrac (istanbul.js:14-16 explains why: a 0.98 shift moves everything 0.925, paddock onto T12). So every frac in the scenery file (0.005, 0.34–0.46, 0.948–1.008 …) is in the same frame as the built lap, and every() phase shift (build-props.js:1385-1389, HKSHIFT) is 0 here.
  • every(m, fn) steps m metres (stp = round(m/ds) nodes, ds≈4 m). Candidate counts over 5 255 m: pine 188, bush 239, tree 119, forestEdge/guardrail by span; the hash filters (h<0.38, h<0.42, h<0.55) and the open areas (0.93–0.08, 0.34–0.46) cut these by roughly half. estimate — placed counts were not instrumented; verify reported 12 trees suppressed by the guard.
  • turns, sectors [0.333,0.667] and bankZones are in lap fractions and consumed through mesh.js:205-240; turn:N is a 1-based index into turns, the cause of defect 1.

Lamps, night, bridges, terrain tables

  • Lamps: none authored in the scenery file; furniture.lamp="post" (istanbul.js:76) drives the engine lamp walk (js/lighting/track-lights.js). Count and spacing not measured here. Night frames show lamp pools along the whole lap.
  • night:false (istanbul.js:25): NIGHT = track._night ?? def.night (build-props.js:240) is a build-time flag; the lit-window / raised-body branch in city.js:207-219 (nightLit) therefore never runs for Istanbul, and the slab and chevron buildings keep their day wall/glass colours when the time of day is switched to night at runtime. This is the likely path behind defect 3 (still a guess about brightness).
  • Bridges / flyovers: none. Terrain: terrainOuter 120; elevation bumps, width zones and banking tables as above; no flatTerrain.
  • Graph parity: graph-parity.cjs refuses to run on a tree equal to HEAD (needs BASE=<ref>); not run, no scenery edit to compare.

Cross-check with the brief / real world

  • Brief (docs/tracks/istanbul.md) cites The Race and Formula1.com for the 2027–2031 return and the Turn 8 hospitality; it states 5.34 km, 14 turns, anticlockwise, Turn 8 as a banked four-apex left. I did not fetch these pages; the real-world facts here are the brief's, not independently verified.
  • Code vs brief: 14 turns ✓ (turns has 14), elevation bumps match the brief's table ✓, hospitality at 0.422 / gap 54 ✓, T8 amphitheatre and empty inside ✓ (spectator hill and camera tower are on the left, inside, at 0.352–0.400: the brief says keep the inside completely clear — a mild contradiction, scenery:89-92), "plant thinly" ✓ (sparse:true, but forestEdge belts at density 0.42 along 0.10–0.91 form near-continuous edges, scenery:351-354).

Ranked defects and suggested fixes (not applied)

1 · The "Turn 8" bank is on a right-hand corner, not the left-hand sweeper (suspected, measured geometry)

measured: bankZones[{turn:6,angleDeg:7,widthM:300}] (js/circuits/istanbul.js:65) resolves to turns[5] = 0.3659, which is a right turn (R≈36 m, curvature peaks 0.357–0.378 are R); the bank lift (1.84 m peak) sits at 0.339–0.394. The amphitheatre terracing, Silver-4 stands, gravel and fence are all on side +1 (right) over 0.34–0.46, i.e. on the inside of that right turn and the outside of the left sweeper at 0.438–0.476 (R 49 m). source: brief says Turn 8 is a long, banked, multi-apex left with the crowd on the outside. guess: the "turn:6" index was assumed to be the real T8 when the turns table is a curvature-peak index.

Fix: re-seat the 7° zone on the left sweeper (e.g. turn: 7 → 0.4384, or a frac ≈ 0.44–0.46) and move/re-check the amphitheatre against it; if the trace really has a right at 0.36, revisit whether the layout (new-track) matches the real T8. Verify with a rendered lap before changing curvature signs.

2 · Hillside tiers render as flat tan planks lying on the grass

Code: tiers are 4 sites × 2 (scenery:331-346, ids istanbul-hillside-t1/t4/t9/t12-n), colour [0.74,0.68,0.52]/[0.66,0.60,0.46] at scenery:343. See day-dry orbit f67 and f83 (also fog/storm). Mechanism: groundedSegments hillside tiers (scenery/istanbul.js:331-346) — 8 m wide, 1.4–2.5 m tall chords, pale tan [0.66–0.74,0.60–0.68,0.46–0.52], at 58–82 m out, read as detached boards or a curling path rather than terrain. Fix: darken/vary toward the grass colour, sink to terrain with a soft top, or drop them (they were added to "cut tris").

3 · Night and dusk: buildings and stands are not darkened

Night dry/rain frames: the apartment slab (scenery:289-293), the main stand and the amphitheatre crowd stay bright cream/white, as though self-lit, while the surrounding grass goes dark; night:false (istanbul.js:25) so no authored night dressing/floodlights. Lamp pools do fire along the lane. guess: building/stand materials ignore the ambient dimming (window or MAT.STONE emissive-like response). Check material ids and the night multiplier in js/render/shared before touching the circuit.

4 · Apartment blocks are not "faint"

Code: building(k, -1, 260 + i*26, 18, 30 + (i%3)*10, 18, {kind:"slab"}) for i<8 (scenery:290-293). Brief: faint pale blocks on one horizon. Built: 8 slabs 30–50 m tall (scenery:289-293), high-contrast windows, one visible from the T3-T4 straight at close range (orbit f17) and at the pit-straight horizon. Fix: lower heights/contrast or push distance beyond 320 m.

5 · Trackside camera at s=0 ends up inside the pit-bay mass

trackside f00 (side +1, dist 30) is black interior of istanbul-pit-bay-* (scenery:133-165, bays at 0.948–1.008 side +1, gap 20). May be a tooling placement artefact rather than a circuit bug — shot.mjs steps round obstacles but did not here. Also the pit-lane surface at the eye f00 view shows a dark checker texture.

6 · Weather response is mild

Day wet barely changes the sky; fog leaves the sky saturated blue above the haze; storm at day is correctly dark-grey (the lighting merge) but pines show planar-reflection ghosting. These are engine-level (js/lighting/atmosphere.js), not circuit defects.

7 · Smaller measured notes

Built length 5 254.8 m vs 5 338 m quoted; min node radius 7.44 m vs hw 7.5 m near node 1157 (inner edge nearly degenerate, no folds); ground audit buries 13 props and 3 severe clip spots stay within baseline — none located by this survey.

Not captured / uncertain

  • No aerial/map views, no cockpit/chase, no pit-lane or race-start frames; only orbit at six fractions plus eye/trackside for day dry. Eye and trackside were not run for the other weathers or for dusk/night.
  • Dusk and night were captured for dry and rain only; no wet/overcast/fog/storm at dusk or night; no dawn.
  • Gallery panels use the same orbit parameters at every position; occlusion by foreground props can hide landmarks (e.g. Silver stands at 0.29 and 0.915 never framed).
  • The three clip spots and 13 buried props were not located; real-place accuracy (layout vs the 2011 Istanbul Park) was not compared against an external trace here — the claim in defect 1 about the real Turn 8 comes from the project brief only.
  • Defect 3 (night brightness) is observed in frames; the cause is not confirmed in the renderer.
